dogecoin.text:
#Bitcoin and #Dogecoin are even worse than the current FED money printer.

At least Bitcoin could be store of value, just like the current banks. But don't use it for transactions - just rarely in and out of your $SCRT wallet.

#Crypto isn't just some magic money and the basic shit like #NFTs, #Bitcoin, #Dogecoin and #Ethereum.

It's human collaboration of 8 billion beings, at planetary scale, unleashed.
Unstoppable. Censorship-resistant. Permanent.
For the next hundreds and thousands of years.
